claims.evidence: The witness confirms a light-colored wooden shelving unit with vertical sections and a hanging rail, used without doors.
The witness cannot determine the age of the item from visual inspection.
The term 'tear' is inapplicable to a wooden wardrobe; the witness notes the condition of surfaces was not shown.
The item is a wooden wardrobe and contains no foam components.
Odors and household history cannot be verified through photos.

risks.proof: A video clip of the unit being shaken from the side.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring additional bracing or repair.

risks.risk: Surface damage (scratches, chips, or peeling laminate)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all exterior panels and shelf edges.

risks.risk: Missing back panel (affects rigidity and dust protection)
risks.proof: A photo showing the rear of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as an incomplete unit without a backboard.

risks.risk: Water or termite damage at the base
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the feet and the bottom-most edges of the wood.
risks.if_unproven: as having base damage from floor moisture.

proof_requests: A video of the unit being shaken to test stability.
Photos of the back of the wardrobe.
Close-up photos of the base and all wooden surfaces to check for scratches or water damage.
response.reason: The witness has identified the item as an open wardrobe. The seller's description is highly suspect as it mentions 'foam' and 'tears' which do not apply to this item, so it must be priced at the lowest functional value for a used wooden unit.
